name: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring the broth and ginger to a simmer and whisk in the arrowroot slurry.
Pour in the beaten egg in a thin stream while stirring.
Finish with green onion, sesame oil and pepper.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
steps: Simmer the broth with the mushrooms, soy sauce and pepper.
Add the tofu and arrowroot slurry.
Stir in the beaten egg and finish with vinegar and green onion.

name: Baked General Tso-Style Chicken
steps: Toss the cubed chicken in egg and arrowroot and bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 15 minutes.
Simmer the soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, ginger, pepper flakes and sweetener for 3 minutes.
Toss with the chicken and steamed broccoli.

name: Orange Chicken with Fresh Juice
steps: Toss the cubed chicken in arrowroot and sear in oil until golden.
Simmer the orange juice, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic and ginger to a glaze.
Coat the chicken and serve with broccoli and green onion.

name: Kung Pao Chicken with Peanuts
steps: Sear the chicken in oil.
Add the pepper, zucchini, garlic, ginger and pepper flakes.
Stir in the soy sauce, vinegar and arrowroot slurry and finish with peanuts and sesame oil.

name: Sweet and Sour Chicken with Pineapple
steps: Sear the cubed chicken in oil.
Add the pepper and onion, then a sauce of paste, vinegar and sweetener thickened with arrowroot.
Fold in the pineapple and serve over rice.

name: Chicken Lo Mein with Vegetables
steps: Boil the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry the sliced chicken in oil, add the vegetables, garlic and ginger.
Toss with the noodles, soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Shrimp with Snow Peas and Garlic Sauce
steps: Sear the shrimp in oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the peas, mushrooms and garlic.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar and arrowroot slurry and return the shrimp.

name: Mongolian-Style Beef with Scallions
steps: Slice the steak thin and toss in arrowroot.
Sear in oil in two batches.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce and sweetener, then the green onion.
Serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Egg Foo Young
steps: Mix the beaten eggs with sprouts, shrimp, green onion and mushrooms.
Pan-fry small patties in oil, 2 minutes a side.
Simmer the broth, soy sauce and arrowroot into a gravy and spoon over.

name: Moo Shu Chicken Lettuce Wraps
steps: Stir-fry the sliced chicken in oil.
Add the vegetables and ginger, then push aside and scramble the eggs.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and spoon into lettuce.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice with Egg
steps: Stir-fry garlic, carrot and peas in oil.
Scramble the eggs in the pan.
Add the cold rice, soy sauce and sesame oil and finish with green onion.

name: Pork and Cabbage Stir-Fry
steps: Brown the pork with garlic and ginger in oil.
Add the cabbage and carrot and stir-fry 5 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and top with green onion.

name: Chicken Marsala
steps: Dust the chicken with arrowroot and sear in oil.
Brown the mushrooms with garlic in butter.
Add wine and broth, return the chicken and simmer 10 minutes.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Cook the spaghetti.
Crisp the bacon with the garlic.
Whisk the eggs with parmesan and pepper.
Toss with the hot pasta off the heat until creamy.

name: Pasta Primavera
steps: Cook the pasta.
Sauté the vegetables and garlic in oil.
Toss together with parmesan and basil.

name: Stuffed Shells with Ricotta and Spinach
steps: Cook the shells al dente.
Mix the ricotta, wilted spinach, egg, parmesan and garlic.
Fill the shells, set on marinara in a dish and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Pasta e Fagioli
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes, broth, beans and seasoning and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook until tender.

name: Italian Wedding Soup
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, parmesan and garlic and roll tiny meatballs.
Simmer the broth and carrot, drop in the meatballs for 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and spinach and cook until tender.

name: Antipasto Salad
steps: Chop the romaine and arrange on a platter.
Add the turkey, mozzarella, artichokes, peppers, olives and tomatoes.
Dress with vinegar and oil.

name: Caprese Chicken Skillet
steps: Sear the chicken in oil, 5 minutes a side.
Add the garlic and tomatoes and cook 4 minutes.
Top with mozzarella to melt and finish with basil and balsamic.

name: Eggplant Rollatini
steps: Slice the eggplant lengthwise and roast until pliable.
Spread with the ricotta and spinach mixture and roll.
Cover with marinara and cheeses and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Zuppa Toscana-Style Soup
steps: Brown the sausage with the onion and garlic.
Add the broth, potatoes and pepper flakes and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the kale and cream and cook 5 minutes.

name: Gyro Chicken Bowls with Tzatziki
steps: Marinate the chicken in oil, lemon and oregano and grill; slice.
Stir the yogurt with grated cucumber, garlic and lemon.
Build bowls from rice, chicken, tomato, onion and feta with tzatziki.

name: Greek Diner Omelet with Feta and Spinach
steps: Sauté the spinach and tomato in oil.
Add the beaten eggs and cook until nearly set.
Top with feta and oregano and fold.

name: Butter Chicken with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Brown the chicken in butter.
Add the onion, garlic, ginger and spices, then the tomato sauce.
Simmer 15 minutes and stir in the cream.
Serve over cauliflower rice.
